title: Dispute
description:
A challenge to billed lines on an invoice, adjudicated by re-verifying the cited receipts rather than by negotiation. Every billable impression under UAP carries a receipt the exchange already verified against what it issued, so a dispute has a determinate answer: either the cited receipts still verify, or they do not. This is the difference from open-web billing disputes, which are settled by whoever has more leverage.

A credit to an advertiser MUST be matched by a clawback from the payees who were paid for the same impressions. An exchange that credits one side without reversing the other is silently absorbing the difference and will not reconcile.

account_id.description: The advertiser account challenging the invoice.

status.$comment:
open              filed, inside the window, not yet adjudicated
  under_review      re-verification in progress
  upheld            every cited receipt failed re-verification
  partially_upheld  some failed
  rejected          all cited receipts re-verified; the payable stands
  withdrawn         the advertiser withdrew it
  expired           the window closed with no adjudication; per 10.4 this resolves in the advertiser's favour

reason_code.$comment: integrity_breach is UAP-specific: the advertiser asserts the answer was composed after the auction, in violation of 7.1. It is adjudicated against the answer-digest commitment, not the impression count.

lines.description: The challenged lines. Each MUST cite the receipts it disputes, so adjudication has something to re-verify.

evidence.description: Optional supporting material. Adjudication does not depend on it; the receipt set is authoritative.

method.$comment: manual is permitted but MUST record who decided; it is the path that does not reconcile automatically.

per_receipt.description: Per-receipt outcome, itemised for the same reason 10.2 itemises rejections.

kind.$comment: credit reduces the invoice and claws back the matching payee shares. make_good leaves the invoice standing and creates an obligation to re-deliver equivalent impressions, so the payee keeps what it earned and earns again on re-delivery.

clawback.description: The reversal applied to each payee, in the same proportions they were originally paid.

recovered_from.$comment: carried_forward means the payout had already been disbursed and the amount is owed against a future period.

deadline_at.description: End of the adjudication window. An exchange that lets this pass resolves the dispute in the advertiser's favour; otherwise ignoring a dispute is a winning strategy.
